# telnyx_number_order (Resource)

An order for phone numbers.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Buys the listed numbers. Telnyx cannot cancel an order: destroying this
# resource only removes it from Terraform state, and the numbers stay in
# your account until you release them.
resource "telnyx_number_order" "main_line" {
  customer_reference = "main-line"
  phone_numbers = [
    { phone_number = "+13125550100" },
  ]

  timeouts = {
    create = "20m"
  }
}
```

## Schema

### Required

- `phone_numbers` (Attributes List) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--phone_numbers))

### Optional

- `billing_group_id` (String) Identifies the messaging profile associated with the phone number.
- `connection_id` (String) Identifies the connection associated with this phone number.
- `customer_reference` (String) A customer reference string for customer look ups.
- `messaging_profile_id` (String) Identifies the messaging profile associated with the phone number.
- `regulatory_requirements` (Attributes List) The API does not return this value, so changes made outside Terraform are not detected. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--regulatory_requirements))
- `timeouts` (Attributes) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--timeouts))

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) An ISO 8901 datetime string denoting when the number order was created.
- `id` (String) The object's id.
- `phone_numbers_count` (Number) The count of phone numbers in the number order.
- `record_type` (String)
- `requirements_met` (Boolean) True if all requirements are met for every phone number, false otherwise.
- `status` (String) The status of the order.
- `sub_number_orders_ids` (List of String)
- `updated_at` (String) An ISO 8901 datetime string for when the number order was updated.
